title: GitHub Security Lab AI agent helps find code injection in Ansys PyMAPDL workflow
ai_system: GitHub Security Lab AI agent and CodeQL
summary: The migrator.yml workflow interpolates a pull request comment body into JavaScript in a privileged GitHub Actions context, risking command execution and secret exposure.
ai_role: GHSL credits CodeQL and its AI agent and reports the finding to Ansys on 2025-08-04; the maintainer fixed it 2025-08-05. The source does not isolate which contributor identified it first.
classification_note: The public advisory documents the vulnerability and disclosure/remediation status. It does not claim exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: Maintainer fixed the issue 2025-08-05. No CVE was established in this advisory.
